text: We absolutely loved our stay! Letty was so kind & always quick to respond, very helpful! The property was so unique & peaceful, such an amazing getaway! Everything was amazing! Thank you so much & we cannot wait to return!

Loved staying at this home for a couple of days on a recent and somewhat last-minute road trip to the DFW area to catch the solar eclipse. Mindy was an incredibly kind and responsive host who made us feel welcome long before we even started our drive to the property. Everything was as expected and beyond for a quality Airbnb experience and we would stay again if similar travel brought us to the area.
Very nice space with a full kitchen. Daria is a very responsive and helpful host!

This place is beautifully decorated and so clean! Felt right at home. Easy to get into. The bed was so comfortable. Lindsay is an amazing host very communicative and accommodating. I have stayed at two of her properties now and both have been too notch experiences. Will definitely stay again.
Ange’s place was super clean and very comfortable. The overall vibe was very homey and we felt safe and comfortable, it was as good as any hotel. Would stay here again.

Decent price and decent place. The room was very dusty however, white night stand have a layer of dust and ceiling fan was coated in thick black dust so we didn't turn it on! Please clean thoroughly. Otherwise quite and nice for a restful night.

Overall this place was solid. I’ll give you the pros and cons Pros - very clean and beautiful inside the apartment! - comfy beds and multiple TVs, pool table and other fun amenities - place looks like the pictures and is located in a walkable location to deep ellum bars and venues - owner is great at communicating and helpful with quick follow up replies Cons - neighborhood is a little sketchy. The train station behind the Airbnb hosts a LOT of homeless who make their way around the building often stumbling. - getting in and out the first time was pretty confusion. Especially exiting. The exit door is behind a door without clear signage. It felt secure, but a bit of a maze even with the pictures and directions provided. - I woke up at 7am to 3+ hours of loud banging and construction next door. I’m sure this is temporary and owner said they weren’t notified of this and would speak to leasing. But unfortunately I didn’t get a great nights sleep. Price wasn’t worth it for me

The condo was nice and good location. However, the bed sheets were dirty with several hair strands. The cleaning crew came and changed the sheets but they were dirty with several hair stands as well (I didn’t check until after they had left). By that time, it was bed time so I used a lint roller and just laid on top. The amount of money that a renter pays in cleaning fees should come with a new set of sheets. Those are cheap sheets that you can get off of Amazon for $20 all day long.
